subject: Pilot compliance pricing & evidence path
messages:
From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@healthnova.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@healthnova.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot compliance pricing & evidence path

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers. We’re planning a 3-month pilot starting Jan with roughly 50k API calls/day (mostly embeddings + chat) and have some specific compliance asks that will drive budget. Quick summary: 
- Audit logs: retention to 13 months, searchable export for legal hold
- KMS/HSM: customer-managed keys (bring your own key) for PHI encrytion
- EU residency: subset of traffic routed to eu-west for EU customers
- HIPAA: BA/controls evidence (SOC2 + HIPAA attestation) and documentation for our security team

We have a constrained pilot budget (~$40k ARR equivalent for the pilot window) and need a line-itemed cost breakdown for the add-ons above plus any implementation fees or evidence delivery cadence (how often and in what format you provide export/evidence).

Attached is our compliance_requirements_v1.pdf with the security team’s baseline questions. Can you put together a pragmatic packaging option for pilot customers (minimal friction) and any concession paths for early-stage customers?

Also looping procurement — please include procurement in replies for contract/PO timing.

Appreciate it,
Karen Liu
Head of Security Programs
HealthNova

Attachment: compliance_requirements_v1.pdf (pdf, 220KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@healthnova.com>, procurement@healthnova.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot compliance pricing & evidence path

Hi Karen — thanks for the clear requirements and the attachment. Below is a pragmatic starter proposal and three concession pathways we can offer for pilots: quick bullets to make procurement easier, then I’ll follow up with an itemized SOW.

High-level pricing (pilot-oriented):
- Audit logs (searchable retention): $0.03/GB ingested / month for active search indexing. Export/forensic bundle (on-demand) $250/export. First 3 months: we can include up to 500GB/month of indexed logs for pilot customers at no charge (option A).
- KMS/HSM options: 
  - BYOK via our KMS integration (no HSM seat): no recurring HSM seat fee, we bill key-management usage (key ops) at $0.01/key-op.
  - Dedicated HSM seat (FIPS 140-2 validated appliance + 24/7 key support): $1,800/month per seat OR one-time setup $14,000 with reduced monthly of $1,200/month.
- Data residency (EU region): 20% surcharge on infra & ingress for eu-west routing OR dedicated EU Dedicated cluster (one-time onboarding $12,000 + regional SLO).
- HIPAA evidence & BA: BA is standard; evidence bundle (SOC2 extracts + HIPAA mapping + packaged evidence delivery) $3,500 one-time for initial package, then $500/mo for quarterly evidence refreshes.

Pilot concession pathways (pick one):
1) Trial credit: $10k pilot credit applied to hosted usage and compliance add-ons for first 3 months (no implementation fee).
2) Waived onboarding for HSM: waive the one-time HSM setup ($14k) and give first-month HSM seat free if customer commits to 12-month reserved commit >= $120k.
3) Blended discount: 15% off compliance add-ons for year one if customer signs a 9–12 month committed spend (thresholds to be defined).

Ask: can you confirm expected daily token volumes / average context lengths and whether PHI will transit the hosted API (versus being restricted to EU-only subset)? That will change sizing and whether we recommend Dedicated vs Hosted + residency.

I’ve attached a short pilot-proposal (one page) that converts the above into an initial SOW. If you’d like, we can propose the concession mix (1 or 2 above) in writing for procurement.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot-proposal-v1.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot compliance pricing & evidence path (internal)

Vanessa / Markus — quick internal note on concession flexibility:
- Approved: up to $8k pilot credit (option 1 scaled) without exec sign-off.
- We can waive the HSM one-time setup ($14k) but only if HealthNova commits to a 12-month reserved capacity >= $120k and accepts a 15% compliance-addons discount for year one.
- If they cannot commit to 12 months, offer 3 months of free indexed audit logs (up to 500GB/mo) + $5k credit.

Finance: I’ll ask for an approval ticket for the $8k credit and the 15% year-one discount; will need a quick deal sketch from you (Vanessa) for TCV math.

-Ben
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@healthnova.com>, procurement@healthnova.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot compliance pricing & evidence path

Hi Karen — thanks for the quick turnaround while we reviewed internally. Summary of the agreed pilot concession (our recommendation based on your budget):

Offer summary (proposal ID DN-8791):
- $8,000 pilot credit applied to hosted usage and compliance add-ons (applies across the first 3 billing periods).
- HSM: waive one-time setup ($14,000) if you sign a 12-month reserved commit >= $120k; otherwise first-month HSM seat free and we’ll bill monthly at $1,800/seat.
- Audit logs: first 3 months include up to 500GB/month of indexed logs at no charge; thereafter $0.03/GB/mo. Exports remain $250/export.
- HIPAA evidence bundle: $3,500 one-time for initial evidence package; 15% discount applied to the evidence bundle for year one under this concession.
- EU residency: we can enable eu-west routing for the subset of traffic you designate; infrastructure surcharge is 20% unless you take Dedicated EU cluster (one-time $12k onboarding).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm token/throughput estimates and whether PHI will transit hosted endpoints.
2) If you want the 12-month reserved commit path (preferred for cost predictability), let us know target TCV and I’ll loop in Finance for the formal commitment schedule.
3) I’ve uploaded an updated pilot SOW to the Drive link below and created a DocuSign envelope for a pilot addendum. If procurement prefers a PO-first flow, we can generate an invoice schedule as an alternative.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3ExampleHealthNovaProposal
DocuSign (pilot addendum): https://www.docusign.com/overview?envelopeId=0a1b2c3d4e

If that looks good I’ll prepare a short appendix for procurement mapping pricing line-items to PO codes.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
